_comment: Hand-written text shown on the review page for the 44 sedarim reviewed 2026-11-07..10. 'recommended' is Claude's recommendation; 'option_notes' describe each option and quote word counts measured on the Westminster Leningrad Codex text. Only options that have a note here were shown for that seder.

items.issue: Day 4 ends inside the sixth day of creation.

option_notes.keep: Splits day six before “Behold, I have given you.”
option_notes.strict: One creation day per reading, with Shabbat (2:1–3) on its own as a short Thursday.
option_notes.even: Evenest, but two days end mid-paragraph.

items.issue: Day 2 ends inside the descent to Egypt, just before the plagues on Pharaoh.

option_notes.keep: Splits the Egypt episode at 12:17.
option_notes.strict: Clean break, but day 2 is only 52 words.
option_notes.scene: The whole Egypt episode (12:10–20) in one reading; the return north starts day 3.

items.issue: Day 4 ends inside the covenant between the pieces, at the birds of prey.

option_notes.keep: Splits the covenant ritual at 15:11.
option_notes.strict: The promise of the stars (15:1–6) and the covenant (15:7–21) each read whole.

items.issue: Day 4 ends mid-dialogue, before Abraham's plea for Yishmaʿel.

option_notes.keep: Cuts the conversation about Sarah's son in half.
option_notes.strict: Clean setuma before Sarah is renamed, but day 5 runs 177 words.
option_notes.scene: Covenant and circumcision together, Sarah and Yiṣḥaq next, then the circumcision carried out (17:23–27).

items.issue: Day 1 ends in the middle of the mob at Loṭ's door.

option_notes.keep: Splits the night scene at 19:9.
option_notes.strict: The night scene (19:1–11) read whole, though day 1 runs 166 words.
option_notes.even: Evener, but adds a second mid-paragraph break.

items.issue: Day 1 ends at the well, while Rivqa waters the camels.

option_notes.keep: Chapter 24 has almost no section breaks, so every split lands mid-story; 24:20 is a reasonable pause.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 1 runs 361 words.
option_notes.even: Evener, but both of the first breaks are mid-paragraph.

items.issue: Uneven week: day 2 (30:28–30) is only 35 words.

option_notes.keep: Short day at the wage negotiation; use the spare time for review.

items.issue: Day 1 ends one verse into Ḥamor's proposal.

option_notes.keep: Splits Ḥamor's speech after its first verse.
option_notes.strict: Clean ʿăliyya break, but day 1 runs 190 words.
option_notes.even: Evener, but adds a second mid-paragraph break.
option_notes.scene: Starts day 2 where Ḥamor begins speaking (34:8), so Dina's story and the negotiation each read whole.

items.issue: Uneven week: day 1 (37:1–4) is only 52 words.

option_notes.keep: Short first day: the coat and the brothers' hatred.
option_notes.even: Evener, but two breaks are mid-paragraph.
option_notes.scene: One scene a day: coat, dreams, the search, the pit, the sale (day 5 runs 163).

items.issue: Day 3 ends while Yosef is handing out gifts for the journey.

option_notes.keep: Splits Pharaoh's invitation scene at 45:22.
option_notes.strict: One scene a day: Yehuda's plea, the revelation, Pharaoh's invitation, Beʾer Shevaʿ, the seventy souls. Two days run past 220 words.

items.issue: Day 4 ends inside the famine land reform.

option_notes.keep: Splits the land reform at 47:24.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 4 is 72 words and day 5 is 170.
option_notes.scene: Land reform whole on day 4; Yaʿaqov's deathbed oath (47:27–31) on day 5.

items.issue: Day 4 ends as the brothers send their message to Yosef.

option_notes.keep: Splits the reconciliation scene at 50:16.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 5 runs 212 words.
option_notes.scene: Starts day 5 where the brothers grow afraid (50:15), so the reconciliation reads whole.

items.issue: Day 1 cuts the four expressions of redemption before “wehevethi.”

option_notes.keep: Breaks between 6:7 and 6:8, inside the promise.
option_notes.strict: The whole promise (6:2–9) in one reading; Moshe's objection (6:10–13) is a short day 2.

items.issue: Day 3 ends in the middle of the Song of the Sea.

option_notes.keep: Splits Shirath HaYam at 15:9.
option_notes.strict: The Song (15:1–19) chanted whole on day 4, at 198 words; the crossing gets days 2 and 3.

items.issue: Uneven week: day 5 (17:14–16) is only 37 words.

option_notes.keep: Short last day at the end of the Amaleq story.
option_notes.even: Evener, but splits the Amaleq battle mid-paragraph.
option_notes.scene: Amaleq (17:8–16) read whole on day 5; the manna jar and Massa uMeriva fill days 1–4.

items.issue: Day 2 ends inside the goat-hair curtains.

option_notes.keep: Splits the second covering at 26:12.
option_notes.strict: Each covering whole, then the boards and bars; days 4–5 are short (41, 52).

items.issue: Day 3 ends inside the breastplate section.

option_notes.keep: The ḥoshen (28:15–30) is one long section, so any even split cuts it; 28:27 is a natural pause at the rings.
option_notes.strict: Also cuts the ḥoshen, at its ʿăliyya, and runs 182 words on day 5.

items.issue: Uneven week: days 1 and 3 are under 50 words.

option_notes.keep: Clean section breaks; days run 43 to 100.
option_notes.even: Evener, but two breaks are mid-paragraph.
option_notes.scene: Moshe's inquiry about the goat (10:16–20) gets its own day.

items.issue: Day 2 ends inside the law of baldness.

option_notes.keep: Splits the baldness case at 13:43.
option_notes.strict: Clean setuma break; day 2 is short (58), day 3 longer (130).

items.issue: Day 4 ends inside the purification of a house.

option_notes.keep: Splits the bird ritual at 14:51.
option_notes.strict: Also cuts the ritual, and day 5 is only 34 words.

items.issue: Uneven week: day 1 is 60 words, day 5 is 133.

option_notes.keep: Clean section breaks.
option_notes.even: Evener, but two breaks are mid-paragraph.

items.issue: Day 1 ends inside the law of the shĕlamim offering.

option_notes.keep: Splits the offering law at 19:7.
option_notes.strict: Keeps the shĕlamim law (19:5–8) whole; day 2 is short (35).

items.issue: Day 3 ends inside the list of forbidden unions.

option_notes.keep: The list has no section marks; any verse in it is a fair pause.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 4 runs 230 words.
option_notes.even: Evener, but adds a second mid-list break.

items.issue: Day 3 ends inside the law of a dedicated field.

option_notes.keep: A fair pause inside one long case.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but days run 42 to 149.

items.issue: Uneven week: day 1 (4:17–20) is only 43 words.

option_notes.keep: One Levite family per day; Qehath's warning stands alone.
option_notes.even: Evener, but two breaks are mid-paragraph.

items.issue: Day 1 ends one verse into the princes' offerings.

option_notes.keep: Splits the opening of chapter 7 after its first verses.
option_notes.strict: Birkath Kohanim (6:22–27) as its own short day, then the offerings.

items.issue: Day 4 ends at 12:8, inside the Miryam episode.

option_notes.keep: 12:9 is where the rebuke turns to punishment; a real scene change.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 5 is only 38 words.

items.issue: Uneven week: day 1 is 161 words, day 5 is 69.

option_notes.keep: Clean section breaks.
option_notes.even: Evener, but two breaks are mid-paragraph.

items.issue: Day 3 ends inside the laws of corpse impurity.

option_notes.keep: Splits the sprinkling law at 19:19.
option_notes.strict: Also cuts the law, and runs 186 words on day 4.
option_notes.scene: The impurity laws (19:11–22) whole; Miryam's death and the water (20:1–13) on days 4–5.

items.issue: Day 4 ends inside the battle with Siḥon, before the poets' song.

option_notes.keep: Splits the Siḥon story at the song (21:27).
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 5 runs 225 words.
option_notes.scene: Siḥon with its song whole on day 4 (211); ʿOg alone on day 5.

items.issue: Day 1 ends inside Bilʿam's second oracle.

option_notes.keep: Splits the oracle at 23:22.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 1 is only 58 words.
option_notes.scene: Setup (23:13–17) on day 1, the second oracle whole on day 2.

items.issue: Day 1 ends before Moshe carries out Yehoshuaʿ's appointment.

option_notes.keep: 27:22 is where the command turns to its fulfillment; a natural pause.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 1 is only 33 words.

items.issue: Day 2 ends inside the laws of vows.

option_notes.keep: 30:14 opens the summary of a husband's powers; a sub-topic start.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but days run 61 to 166.
option_notes.even: Evener, but adds a second mid-paragraph break.

items.issue: Day 1 ends inside Moshe's rebuke of Gad and Reʾuven.

option_notes.keep: Splits the rebuke at 32:9.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 1 is 56 words and day 2 is 152.
option_notes.scene: The request (32:1–5) on day 1, the whole rebuke (32:6–15) on day 2.

items.issue: Day 2 ends inside the list of encampments.

option_notes.keep: It is a list; any station is a fair pause.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 3 is only 47 words.

items.issue: Uneven week: day 5 (35:6–8) is only 50 words.

option_notes.keep: Clean section breaks; no better split exists.

items.issue: Day 1 ends at 4:4, inside Moshe's opening charge.

option_notes.keep: 4:5 (“See, I have taught you”) begins a new thought.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 1 runs 240 words.

items.issue: Day 4 ends inside the list of wonders in Egypt.

option_notes.keep: Splits the list at 11:4.
option_notes.strict: The list (11:2–9) read whole on day 5; day 3 is short (62).

items.issue: Uneven week: day 3 (15:19–23) is only 60 words.

option_notes.keep: Firstlings as their own short day.
option_notes.even: Evener, but breaks inside the Pesaḥ laws.

items.issue: Day 2 ends inside the ʿegla ʿărufa ritual.

option_notes.keep: Splits the ritual at 21:6.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 1 runs 170 words.
option_notes.scene: War laws on day 1, the ʿegla ʿărufa whole on day 2, then one family law per day.

items.issue: Three days end inside the curses (28:15–68).

option_notes.keep: The curses are one unbroken setuma; the only split possible is by verse.
option_notes.strict: Puts all the curses on one 777-word day.

items.issue: Days 2 and 3 end inside the warnings after the covenant.

option_notes.keep: 29:20 and 29:26 each open a new consequence; fair pauses.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 3 runs 193 words.

items.issue: Day 2 ends inside Haʾazinu.

option_notes.keep: The song is verse by verse; 32:24 is a fair pause.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but days run 68 to 160.

items.issue: Day 4 ends at Moshe's burial, before his epitaph.

option_notes.keep: 34:7 (“Moshe was 120 years old”) begins the epitaph; a real scene change.
option_notes.strict: Clean, but day 5 runs 176 words.
